subject: Re: Evaluation materials handoff & MAP — BrightCart POC
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@brightcart.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation dataset + MAP request for BrightCart POC

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. The BrightCart product team liked the latency profile from the demo — we'd like to move forward with a short POC focused on listings normalization and query rewriting.

To progress we need two things from Redwood:
- A mutually agreed MAP that lays out milestones, durations, and ownership (legal is lightweight on our side but needs the checklist)
- A prompt pack + representative testcases we can run in our staging environment (non-prod, walled off)

Can your team share a MAP draft and a small prompt/testcase bundle we can both sign off on? Our procurement team also asked for a simple statement of usage constraints (retention, no redistribution). Attaching our internal intake form for context.

Thanks — we want to kick off in the week of Aug 4 if possible.

--
Aisha Malik
Head of Procurement, BrightCart
procurement@brightcart.com
Attachment: brightcart_intake_form.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@brightcart.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation dataset + MAP request for BrightCart POC

Aisha — thanks, and great to hear the team found the demo useful.

I've attached a proposed MAP (BRIGHTCART_MAP_v1.docx), plus the prompt pack and a small CSV with representative testcases (brightcart_promptpack_v2.zip, testcases_sample.csv). Key points in the MAP:

- Scope: evaluation-only access to prompt pack and testcases, limited to BrightCart staging (no production use)
- Retention: Redwood retains copy for 120 days by default; BrightCart will certify deletion on completion
- Access: ephemeral access tokens; no downloads permitted outside the sandbox environment except the CSV of anonymized testcases
- Accept criteria: functional parity on 5 canonical prompts, latency targets within agreed SLOs
- Close timeline: sign MAP -> provide staging credentials -> 2-week evaluation window -> acceptance review -> certificate of deletion

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Please confirm the staging hostnames and the security contact for the environment
2) Confirm you can accept the 120-day retention (we can negotiate to 90 if needed)
3) Who will sign on behalf of BrightCart (procurement or legal)?

If you prefer, we can route the MAP through DocuSign. I included a link to a draft envelope in the related links.

Cheers,
--
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
Attachment: BRIGHTCART_MAP_v1.docx; brightcart_promptpack_v2.zip; testcases_sample.csv

Two small redlines from our side:
- Retention: 120 days (instead of 90)
- Non-redistribution: please add explicit prohibition on sharing the prompt pack with third-party contractors without prior written consent

We can sign on behalf of BrightCart (procurement will countersign). I've attached our updated procurement form for reference. If David from legal needs to be looped, let me know.

On timing: the week of Aug 4 still works. Please send the final DocuSign when you can.

Aisha — thanks for the quick review and the procurement form. We can accept the 120-day retention and will add the explicit non-redistribution clause you requested. Two clarifications to lock before I send the DocuSign envelope:

1) Deletion certification: BrightCart will confirm deletion of any intermediate copies from the staging environment and confirm by email to security@redwood.com within 7 days of the acceptance review.
2) Use restriction: materials are evaluation-only; Redwood retains right to metric/anonymized telemetry but will not use raw testcases for model training without explicit consent.

If those look good I will:
- Update the MAP with the changes and route via DocuSign (DocuSign: 0a1b2c3d)
- Share the staging token and access instructions to your security contact
- Schedule the kickoff for Monday Aug 4 (30-min sync to align acceptance checklist)

Please reply with the name/email of the signer and I'll get the envelope out.

Best,
--
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
